name: Yamben
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Only subclassification/endangerment refs (Pick 2019/2020); no descriptive phonology located

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew Nicholas. 2020. A reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert phonology and lexicon. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa. hdl:10125/73354
sources.note: Nothing on Yamben; Yamben is mentioned only as a non-Northern-Adelbert language excluded from the study (refers back to Pick 2018/2019).

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2019. Yamben: A previously undocumented language of Madang. Abstract, 5th Workshop on the Languages of Papua (WLP5), Universitas Negeri Papua, Manokwari. 1 p.
sources.note: Nothing; one-page abstract summarising inventory (three stop places, five vowels, palatal nasal, labiovelar series) and morphology.

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2019. Yamben: A previously undocumented language of Papua New Guinea. In Mitsuko Suzuki (ed.), 2018 Proceedings: Selected papers from the twenty-second college-wide conference for students in languages, linguistics & literature, 25-35. Honolulu: College of Languages, Linguistics & Literature, University of Hawai'i at Manoa. hdl:10125/63092
sources.note: Nothing. Section 3.0 Phonology (p. 27-28) gives a tentative consonant inventory (incl. /ɲ/, /kʷ gʷ mʷ/), a five-vowel system, intervocalic lenition of /b/, and post-nasal prenasalization across morpheme boundaries; no mention of stress, accent, tone or syllable structure anywhere in the paper or its wordlist appendix.

sources.citation: TransNewGuinea.org, language page 'Yamben' (yamb1257), 20 lexical items from Pick (2019)
sources.note: Nothing; wordlist only, sole source Pick 2019.
